email.subject: Lakeview - BC-6107 broken tiles
email.body:
Hi,

Tiles in the L2 restrooms at Lakeview were cracked when your crew stacked board on them. We had them replaced.

BC-6107: broken tiles, L2 restrooms, $780.00.

Also, we're holding $5,000 retainage, separate from this.

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz
Project Manager, Apex Builders
